notes: 4 tests x 50 = 200, every item in exactly one test (pools exactly 4x each count). Per test HF1 8, HF2 10, HF3 24, HF4 8 (16/20/48/16 %, the Rahmenplan 2023 split 15/20/50/15). Training: five topic sets 22001-22005 by Handlungsfeld (HF1 32, HF2 40, HF3 Lernen+Methoden 52, HF3 Begleitung+Beurteilung 44, HF4 32) + 4 tests = 9 dashboard steps. passPct 70 = Tigertest's target (35 of 50); the real written part passes at 50 of 100 points, but multi-answer tasks score all or nothing.
